drivingQuestion: From where is placing hands (semikha) limited to men?
outcomeNote: the verse supplies the mishna's source

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ סְמִיכוֹת. דִּכְתִיב: ״דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל... וְסָמַךְ״ – בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל סוֹמְכִים, וְאֵין בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל סוֹמְכוֹת.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» From where is it derived that «placing» of «hands» on the head of an offering applies only to men? «As it is written: “Speak to the sons of Israel…and he shall place» his hand” (Leviticus 1:2–4), which indicates that «the sons of Israel place hands» on offerings, «but the daughters of Israel do not place hands.»
